name: assessment-suite-data
description: Document preparation and reports for Assessment Suite: PDF conversion, answers grouped by question, student reports and numerical summaries.
long_description: One of the two Assessment Suite servers. Install the assessment server as well, and choose the same workspace folder for both. The server reads and writes only inside the workspace. The application downloads Python and the server's dependencies on first start. Material shown in the conversation is processed by the AI service the application uses.

workspace.title: Workspace folder
workspace.description: The folder holding your assessment projects. Choose the same folder for both Assessment Suite servers.

methodology.title: Methodology folder (optional)
methodology.description: Your own editable copy of the methodology folder. Leave empty to use the methodology included in the package.
